manaNeeded: {9}{W} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters you control
description:
Csat Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {W}.
If you control at least 6 Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Stormsplitter tokens, adding {3}.
Repeat.
